a Pd NP/Pd film/Ni O film structure was prepared to fabricate a HCHO sensor.

the preparation and characterization of a NiO-based sensor decorated with Pd nanoparticles (NPs)/Pd film for the detection of HCHO.
the development of a Pd nanoparticle/Pd film/Ni O thin film-based formaldehyde sensor with enhanced performance.
the fabrication and performance of formaldehyde (HCHO) gas sensor based on a NiO-based sensor decorated with Pd nanoparticles (NPs) and a Pd thin film.

Pd NP/Pd film/Ni semiconductor structures are promising for formaldehyde gas sensing.

the Pd NP-decorated Pd film/Ni O film device shows better sensing performance for formaldehyde than that of the pristine NiO film.

the Pd NP/Pd film/Ni metal-oxide structure can be a potential candidate for formaldehyde gas sensors with high sensitivity and selectivity.
the Pd NPs/Pd thin film/NiO structure can be used as a formaldehyde gas sensing material with a low detection level and a high response.
